input.text: Root scoped self-review: check the typed error boundary for subprocess.TimeoutExpired from the trusted planner (timeout=120) and existing workflow YAML subprocess (timeout=20). plan_main currently catches CalledProcessError but not TimeoutExpired; an unhandled timeout would escape as a traceback instead of the approved verification-ci-error/v1 exit-2 contract. Add a genuine failing timeout-boundary test and the smallest in-scope correction; also retain diagnostics without exposing raw command/environment secrets. No new feature or frozen-document change requested. Complete the final regressions after this correction.
